target_customer: Teams and managers who set and track goals and OKRs
problem: Teams write vague goals and fail to update them; Stellar used GPT to draft SMART goals, link an OKR tree and nudge weekly updates.
product_category: OKR and goal tracking software, AI

founders.name: Angela Dao
prior_employers: LinkedIn (product design leader, per another YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: GPT prompts plus standard SaaS goal tracking and notifications.

defensibility.rationale: Goal tracking was crowded and GPT features were easy to copy.

market_need_then: Not documented in sources dated 2022; the YC launch post (about December 2022) says OKRs slip without updates.

branding.domain_note: stellarapp.io; the domain is now a crypto casino comparison site

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with the Stellar blockchain and others; domain later taken over by an unrelated site.

outcome_analysis: Stellar launched a goals product in 2022 and 2023 and was funded by a 500K note, but YC lists it Inactive and stellarapp.io now hosts an unrelated casino guide. No shutdown notice or cause is public. A generic name shared with larger Stellar brands and a crowded OKR market are possible contributors; brand confusion is a weak inference, recorded as the only supportable factor.
notes: The convertible note rests on one database (CB Insights, 7 September 2022); VCBacked shows 500K pre-seed August 2022. The 2.7M seed in search results belongs to Stellar Technology Services of Indianapolis, a different company. CB Insights lists Tability, Mesh and Mooncamp as related, undated, so none recorded. Cause of inactivity is not public.
